Are you ready to learn fast and make a real impact, working side by side with a small, close-knit team in Ghent? At Corlutions, we've been helping companies grow with Odoo since 2019, and we're expanding our team to do even more of that.
 

 
 

About Corlutions
 

Corlutions is a digitalization partner for small and medium-sized enterprises, specializing in Odoo-based solutions that help organizations reduce costs and increase revenue. We work closely with clients across sectors like manufacturing, construction, wholesale, and finance — always living by our principle: "Together is better."
 

 
 

What is a Business Analyst at Corlutions?
 

As a Business Analyst, your mission is to help our clients optimize their business processes through smart, well-implemented software — primarily Odoo and Business Intelligence. You'll gather and document business requirements, and translate them into clear functional specifications that guide every project.
 

You'll work closely with clients to ensure optimal use of Odoo apps such as Accounting, Point of Sales, eCommerce, Manufacturing, Inventory, Projects, Websites, Sales and more. By diving into your client's needs and processes, and providing personalized training, you'll become the go-to expert for their management solutions.
 

In your first weeks, you'll get comprehensive training before jumping into your first projects — always with the support of your mentor and colleagues. As you gain experience, you'll gain autonomy too. Collaboration stays key throughout: you'll be in regular contact with clients, developers, and the internal team.
 

 
 

Responsibilities
 

Project Implementation (80%)
 
 

• Gain the trust of your customers 

• Analyse needs, gather and document requirements, and suggest and implement solutions (configuration, development and testing) 

• Provide training 

• Follow-up and communication about ongoing tasks  

Internal improvement (20%)
 
 

• Feedback to the internal team 

• Mentoring and training 

• Feedback for improvement  

Optional: support other domains such as marketing, HR and accounting at Corlutions (impacts the % split above).
 

 
 

What's great about the job?
 

Expect real responsibility from day one, in a friendly and open environment where you'll work both independently and collaboratively. You'll take on a variety of projects across different industries, broadening your experience along the way. As a bonus, you'll go through an in-depth training provided by Odoo.
 

 
 

What we offer
 
 

• Sponsored events — afterworks and team buildings 

• Trainings — a real learning and development program 

• Green coworking space — we work from Pentagon, a green coworking space surrounded by water in Ghent 

• Sport activity — play any sport with colleagues, the bill might be covered! 

• Eat & drink — fruit basket and coffee on the house  

 
 

Ready to start your adventure? Apply now

Must Have
 
 

• Bachelor or Master's degree 

• Fluent in English and Dutch 

• Strong analytical mindset, with an interest in business analysis 

• Good communication and negotiation skills 

• Autonomous, assertive & proactive 

• Affinity with the IT world, and interest in Odoo, ERP and Business Intelligence tools 

• Learn fast and have a "Can Do" attitude  

Nice to Have
 
 

• Background in Business Administration, Applied Economics, Civil Engineering, Computer Sciences, or Business Intelligence experience 

• Fluent in French 

• Experience across different domains (marketing, HR, accounting) is a plus 

• Technical knowledge (XML, Python, JS, SQL, programming)

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Join our Technical Department team as a Production Support Technician! In this role, you will be responsible for developing work instructions and methods, as well as providing the necessary production tools to ensure smooth workflow in the workshops and high-quality outcomes for our customers.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:

• You analyze the technical information obtained from the manufacturer via the Engineering department and integrate it into the ERP system.
• You are responsible for writing, updating and translating the technical working documents, taking into account the strict application of the aviation regulations and the instructions of the manufacturer. You ensure the implementation of the technical working documents in the workshops and ensure their correct application.
• You participate in the continuous improvement processes within the department.
• You participate and/or coordinate the improvements of the current working methods and introduce possible new technologies. You ensure the sharing of information as a result of 'retour d'expérience' (RETEX) by means of an infoshop for the mechanics in case of new or improved work instructions.
• You provide technical support to the workshops, both theoretical and practical (if necessary), and look for solutions in case of problems in order to avoid a delay of the production process. You ensure the delivery of the necessary tooling to the workshops and guarantee its correct use by drawing up adequate work instructions.
• You participate in the industrialisation (MRO and NEW) of new types of engines.
• You make repair proposals to the manufacturer in order to make the parts repairable.
• You draw up specifications for the means of production.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in electromechanics or aeronautics, preferably with a first experience in repair methods.
• You speak French or Dutch, with a good knowledge of the other national language and you are willing to improve your skills. You also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• You have good knowledge of electromechanics, mechanics and repair technologies.
• You have knowledge of engines and engine parts.
• You are an analytical and synthetic person and can anticipate.
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and you are willing to support your colleagues.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
